name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 35 - Am 119
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 35 b. Expresses deep concern that the Commission has financed or co-financed campaigns promoting the wearing of the headscarf, stating for example that “freedom is in the hijab”; insists that, in the future, the Union budget must no longer finance any campaign that directly or indirectly promotes the wearing of the headscarf;
